name: R-2
description: Continuity bridging, orchestration, drift monitoring, and ethical enforcement agent for aurora-cloudbank-symbolic

# R-2 Agent

R-2 is an advanced repository agent that maintains project continuity across repos, orchestrates workflows, monitors and remediates configuration drift, and enforces ethical and compliance guidelines. It is designed to act as a reliable "continuity bridge" across collaboration surfaces, syncing context and status while triggering or responding to events.

## Responsibilities

- Continuity Bridging
  - Maintain and transfer context across issues, PRs, discussions, and external repos
  - Preserve decision history and rationale across branches and forks
  - Synchronize status between primary and satellite repositories (bi-directional when permitted)
- Orchestration
  - Coordinate multi-repo workflows; sequence tasks and pass artifacts/state between jobs
  - Trigger follow-up actions based on events and policy
  - Resolve conflicts between concurrent automation tasks via policy-driven arbitration
- Drift Monitoring
  - Detect config drift in workflows, environment files, action versions, and policy files
  - Propose or open PRs to remediate drift; alert on breaking or risky changes
  - Track dependency and runner image version skew affecting reproducibility
- Ethical Enforcement
  - Enforce repository ethics/policy guardrails (privacy, IP, safety constraints)
  - Validate task requests against policy; escalate or request human review on violations
  - Provide auditable logs of enforcement decisions and overrides

## Permission Levels

- Repo Configuration
  - Read/modify selected files under .github/ (workflows, action configs, agents)
  - Open branches/PRs in this repo; comment on issues/PRs
- Data Capsule Management
  - Access and update scoped context capsules stored under .github/agents/state/
  - Redact/scrub sensitive artifacts before external syncs
- Workflow and Event Triggers
  - Trigger, re-run, or cancel specific workflows permitted by policy
  - Emit and subscribe to custom events (repository_dispatch, workflow_call)
- API Endpoint Execution
  - Call approved internal endpoints (see API section) to read/update status
  - Perform cross-repo operations via GitHub REST/GraphQL with least-privilege tokens

## Configuration Options

Define under .github/actions-config.yml (or inline workflow env):

- Customizable Event Hooks
  - inbound_events: [pull_request, push, issues, repository_dispatch, schedule]
  - outbound_events: [repository_dispatch, workflow_dispatch, workflow_call]
- Notification Settings
  - channels: [issues_comment, commit_status, checks, discussion]
  - severity_thresholds: { info, warn, critical }
- Agent Chaining
  - chain_with: [R-1, R-3]  # downstream agents to call with context
  - handoff_policies: { on_success, on_failure, on_drift_detected }
- External Repo Linking Criteria
  - allowlist_repos: [org/upstream-repo, org/downstream-repo]
  - link_rules: { label:cross-repo-sync, topic:aurora-cloudbank }

Example config snippet:

```yaml
agents:
  R-2:
    enabled: true
    inbound_events: [pull_request, push, issues, repository_dispatch]
    outbound_events: [repository_dispatch]
    notifications:
      channels: [issues_comment, checks]
      severity_threshold: warn
    chain_with: [R-1, R-3]
    handoff_policies: [on_success, on_drift_detected]
    allowlist_repos:
      - AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic
      - AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-runtime
    link_rules:
      label: cross-repo-sync
```

## Registration in Central Workflows

R-2 participates as an active agent in:
- .github/workflows/collab-sync.yml
- .github/actions-config.yml (agent registry)
- Any workflow using repository_dispatch or workflow_call named: r2.context-transfer, r2.status-sync, r2.workflow-trigger

Required additions:

1) .github/workflows/collab-sync.yml

```yaml
name: collab-sync
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [r2.context-transfer, r2.status-sync, r2.workflow-trigger]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/30 * * * *'
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write
  checks: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  r2-context-transfer:
    if: github.event.action == 'r2.context-transfer' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Load agent config
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            core.setOutput('ok', true)
      - name: R-2 context sync
        uses: AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic/.github/actions/r2-context-sync@main
        with:
          allowlist: ${{ toJson(fromJson(env.R2_ALLOWLIST)) }}
  r2-status-sync:
    if: github.event.action == 'r2.status-sync'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: R-2 status propagation
        uses: AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic/.github/actions/r2-status-sync@main
  r2-workflow-trigger:
    if: github.event.action == 'r2.workflow-trigger'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Dispatch downstream workflow
        uses: peter-evans/repository-dispatch@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.R2_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ inputs.repository || 'AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-runtime' }}
          event-type: r2.accept-handoff
          client-payload: ${{ inputs.payload || '{}' }}
```

2) .github/actions-config.yml

```yaml
agents:
  R-2:
    enabled: true
    capabilities:
      - continuity-bridge
      - orchestration
      - drift-monitor
      - ethics-enforcement
    permissions:
      repo-config: write
      data-capsule: write
      workflows: write
      api-exec: read
    workflows:
      - collab-sync.yml
    events:
      in: [pull_request, push, issues, repository_dispatch]
      out: [repository_dispatch]
```

## Onboarding and API

Activation
- Ensure actions are enabled; add R-2 entry in .github/actions-config.yml
- Set secrets.R2_TOKEN with least privilege for cross-repo dispatch
- Enable collab-sync.yml workflow on default branch

Configuration
- Tune inbound/outbound events and notifications in actions-config.yml
- Update allowlist_repos and link_rules per collaboration topology
- Optionally chain to other agents via chain_with and handoff_policies

Usage
- Context transfer: send repository_dispatch with type r2.context-transfer and payload
- Status sync: send repository_dispatch with type r2.status-sync
- Workflow trigger: send repository_dispatch with type r2.workflow-trigger and target repo

Sample API endpoint (GitHub REST via repository_dispatch)

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $R2_TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic/dispatches \
  -d '{
    "event_type": "r2.context-transfer",
    "client_payload": {"source":"repoA#123","targets":["repoB#456"],"note":"handoff"}
  }'
```

Sample workflow usage (call from another repo)

```yaml
name: handoff-to-r2
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  handoff:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: peter-evans/repository-dispatch@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.R2_TOKEN }}
          repository: AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic
          event-type: r2.workflow-trigger
          client-payload: '{"repository":"AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-runtime","payload":{"task":"sync-status"}}'
```

## Interactions with Other Agents and Contributors

- Other agents can subscribe to r2.accept-handoff and reply with r2.handoff-complete
- Contributors can mention @R-2 in issues/PRs; R-2 reacts per actions-config policy
- All enforcement and drift findings are logged to checks and issue comments with severity labels

## Notes

- R-2 operates on least-privilege credentials and will request elevation via PRs if required
- All cross-repo actions require allowlist and link_rules to pass; otherwise R-2 no-ops and comments with rationale
